titulo: ‘When the sun came out it felt like it opened a scar’ – This is climate breakdown
cuerpo: When the floods hit Pakistan he went out to help. Then the water reached his own family. This is Imran Lodhi’s story Location: Dera Ghazi Khan, Pakistan Disaster: Pakistan intense monsoon rainfall Imran Lodhi is a university lecturer with a doctorate in climate change and sustainable development . The 41-year-old was living in Dera Ghazi Khan , a city in south-western Punjab, when floods devastated provinces across Pakistan . Climate change made the monsoon rainfall that caused the floods more intense . Continue reading...
